name: Sandeep Vaid
summary: Data-focused backend engineer with 4+ years building large-scale ETL pipelines, data reconciliation engines, and warehouse integrations. Ingested 100M+ records/day with 99.9% consistency; optimized crore-scale PostgreSQL workloads from hours to minutes; hands-on with Snowflake, Redshift, and AWS. Seeking senior data/backend engineering roles.

bullets: Architected and owned end-to-end delivery of a fault-tolerant ETL pipeline ingesting 100M+ government education records daily across 6+ Indian states — processing School, Student, and Employee datasets from NIC UDISE+ APIs using parallel batch extraction and PostgreSQL transactional staging with rollback, achieving 99.9% data consistency across distributed sync operations.

Designed and rearchitected a column-level differential reconciliation engine comparing 4–5 crore rows × 80–90 columns across MIS and UDISE databases — identified Materialized View upsert limitations at 7 crore diff scale, migrated to indexed PostgreSQL tables with a pre-aggregated summary layer, reducing processing from hours to minutes.

Built centralized log management and observability layer across 6+ ETL pipelines — replaced manual per-pipeline error file sharing with a unified real-time dashboard used by Engineering, Product, and QA, eliminating 30–60 min per-incident debug handoff across 3 teams.
Implemented production-grade recovery system using exponential backoff retry logic, health-check endpoints, AWS CloudWatch logging, and Slack webhook integration.
Migrated RBAC and Field Master configuration layer from DynamoDB to PostgreSQL — redesigned schema and wrote migration verification scripts.

Led architecture-to-production delivery for government MIS platform serving 6+ Indian state education boards — owning technical design, CI/CD pipelines, and cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Product, QA, and state program managers to ensure contractual delivery milestones.
Engineered advanced search algorithms for guides, reducing search times by 2.35 seconds through intelligent filtering based on date, type, language, location, and booking status.
Integrated AWS Cognito for advanced authentication capabilities and developed lambda functions to incorporate bespoke authentication logic and user authentication.
Orchestrated the end-to-end implementation of Guide products across backend, frontend, and mobile app platforms, ensuring seamless integration and functionality.
Spearheaded the development to deployment process of a customizable React theme-editor using hooks, Redux, and Saga, optimizing asynchronous operations to show itinerary details.
Contributed to the enhancement of the guide mobile app built with react-native, refining user interface and experience design elements and publishing it on the Play Store.
Optimized event server performance with JSON schema validation, increasing throughput to 50,000 requests/second.
Built an image-to-text extraction pipeline using OCR, generating AI-powered product recommendations from extracted attributes.
Developed a Shopify script for real-time behavioral data collection across e-commerce platforms using Google Tag Manager integrations.
Architected a reusable service layer for configuration, dashboard, and task & dependency management — reducing manual operational workload by 80%.
Built an Administration Console with role-based access control (RBAC), enabling configuration management and real-time system monitoring.
Engineered a dynamic HTML and CSS code generator using Angular, reducing UI customization time for internal teams.

skills: Node.js, Express.js, Django, Dropwizard, Spring Boot
AWS Lambda, AWS DynamoDB, AWS S3, AWS CloudWatch, AWS Cognito, Cron Scheduling, CI/CD, Serverless Architecture, Snowflake, Redshift, EC2, Elastic Beanstalk
